rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a harbor or offshore area where ships can anchor.

example.english: This anchorage can accommodate several cargo ships.
example.traditional: 呢個錨地可以泊幾隻貨船。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 naau4 dei6 ho2 ji5 paak3 gei2 zek3 fo3 syun4

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that provides dependable support or security.

example.english: With you as my anchorage, I’m not afraid of losing my job.
example.traditional: 有你做我靠山，我就唔驚失業喇。
example.jyutping: jau5 nei5 zou6 ngo5 kaau3 saan1 ngo5 zau6 m4 geng1 sat1 jip6 laa3
